name: cgs-attendance-monorepo
description: CGS Attendance - Digital School Attendance System Monorepo

scripts.build:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.build:backend: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.build:netlify: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/copy-next.js
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/copy-next.js
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
